title: laraplate-edge-config/1 document (structural copy kept by the MES module)
description: The structure the backend checks before it publishes a configuration version: the top-level keys, the schema name, an integer version and the component lists, each item an object with a string id. Driver, output and plugin fields are not interpreted. Replaced by the schema laraplate-edge publishes once it exists.

version.description: Written by the backend on publish: always the stored version number.
